command:
for f in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do
  grep -qsa git "$f" || continue
  pid=${f%/cmdline}; pid=${pid##*/}
  t=$(awk '{print $22}' /proc/$pid/stat 2>/dev/null) || continue
  u=$(awk '{print int($1*100)}' /proc/uptime)
  [ $(( (u - t) / 100 )) -gt 180 ] && exit 1
done
exit 0

# Ownership fix only. Schema creation/migration is owned by the
# 2.0.0 binary's own migrate() at boot (idempotent) — do NOT
# apply schema/migration SQL here. The one-shot pre-2.0.0 db
# reset ran 2026-07-21 (commit c164a36b) and must not recur.
chown -R 65532:65532 /data 2>/dev/null || true
initContainers.name: init-schema
